commands.help: Load and run a C/C++ PE file in memory (manual features mask).
commands.long_help:
Usage: inline-execute-cpp <features_hex> <force 0|1> <stdin_file|-> <exe_path> [cmdline] [vfs|'-'] <jobver 0|1|2>

features_hex for C/C++ = 0x33F. Use 0x0 to disable hooks.
Pass '-' for stdin and vfs if not needed.
jobver: 0 for CS <4.0, 1 for 4.0-4.8, 2 for 4.9+. For Sliver use 0.

Example: inline-execute-cpp 0x33F 0 - C:\Tools\mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug sekurlsa::logonpasswords exit" - 0

arguments.name: stdin
arguments.desc: File to use as stdin, or '-' for empty (empty file path workaround: pass any empty file)

arguments.name: exe_path
arguments.desc: Path to the C/C++ PE file

arguments.name: vfs
arguments.desc: VFS mapping file, or '-' for empty

commands.help: Load and run a golang PE file in memory (manual features mask).
commands.long_help:
Usage: inline-execute-go <features_hex> <force 0|1> <stdin_file|-> <exe_path> [cmdline] [vfs|'-'] <jobver 0|1|2>

features_hex for Go = 0x3003F. Use 0x0 to disable hooks.
For Sliver use jobver=0.

Example: inline-execute-go 0x3003F 0 - C:\Tools\HackBrowserData.exe "" - 0

arguments.name: stdin
arguments.desc: File to use as stdin, or '-' for empty

arguments.name: exe_path
arguments.desc: Path to the golang PE file

arguments.name: vfs
arguments.desc: VFS mapping file, or '-' for empty

commands.help: List all loaded PE images with details.
Fetch logs and complete stdout/stderr from a running PE image.
commands.long_help:
Usage: inline-log-pe <image_base_hex> <silent 0|1>

image_base_hex: e.g. 0x008D0000
silent: 1 to suppress 'not found' errors (auto-trigger), 0 for manual.

Example: inline-log-pe 0x008D0000 0
Example: inline-log-pe 0x0 0

arguments.name: imagebase
arguments.desc: Image base hex (0x0 for last loaded)
